title: Estimate feature footprint from WMBT, interface and layer cues

facts.note: Task text asks the planner to size or estimate a feature.
Needs a phase observer to know the planner is authoring/sizing a feature plan rather than implementing.
Whether the artifact being authored carries a footprint estimate is judged from content.

fires: Planner writes or revises a feature plan that states an architectural footprint / size estimate
Planner sizes a feature from whatever WMBTs, interfaces and component layers are available, including when some of these inputs are still incomplete or undeclared
doesNotFire: Planner editing docs or acceptances without producing any footprint estimate

given: A planner is sizing a feature
when: The planner estimates the feature's architectural footprint
then: Derive the footprint from the feature's WMBTs, interfaces and component layers by mapping each estimation cue (signal -> footprint element) to its footprint element, rather than guessing a size.
prefer: WMBT display/animation signals -> count a screen/view
WMBT apply/validate signals -> count an endpoint
WMBT reconcile/persist signals -> count a table/migration
WMBT notify/retry/queue signals -> count async work
Backend repository-layer components -> count a table/migration
Frontend presentation-layer components -> count the number of screens
avoid: Estimating footprint without tracing it to WMBTs, interfaces and component layers
why: WMBT verbs, interfaces and component layers are concrete signals of which architectural elements (screens, endpoints, tables, async work, events, integrations) a feature will need, so footprint estimates grounded in them are repeatable and feed footprint scoring.
evidence: Reviewer can trace each footprint element in the estimate back to a WMBT signal, interface (event / external consumes-produces) or component layer per the cue mapping
Counts of screens, endpoints, tables/migrations, async work, events and integration points are consistent with the cues present in the plan
verifier_detail: Cue map (term estimation_cue, 'signal -> footprint element'): display_animation -> screen/view; apply_validate -> endpoint; reconcile_persist -> table/migration; notify_retry_queue -> async; new_events -> event count; external_consumes_produces -> integration points; be_repository -> table/migration; fe_presentation -> number of screens
